releases.name: v0.2.0 — Bilingual (EN default + pt-BR)
releases.body:
First English release. The UI and prompts now default to **English**, with Brazilian Portuguese available via the `language` option.

### Highlights
- **Internationalization (i18n):** all user- and model-facing strings moved to `en`/`pt` dictionaries in `src/messages.ts`.
- **English by default:** sidebar, progress render, tool/command descriptions, system rules, `/target` kickoff and idle continuation are English unless `language: "pt"` is set.
- **`language` option:** `"en"` (default) or `"pt"`. The server stores the language on the checklist state so the TUI renders in the same language.
- **English README.**

### Usage
```jsonc
{ "plugin": [ ["checklist-to-goal", { "language": "pt" }] ] }
```

Published on npm as `checklist-to-goal@0.2.0`.
